long_biography.plain_text:
Björn built his career in Gävle, establishing a long-term base in property ownership and management. He expanded by acquiring companies, often taking board roles while helping their operations grow. Those purchases broadened the group from rental housing and commercial premises into construction, transport, industrial products and marine services.

He consolidated the portfolio under Gästrike Nord Invest, which he owns outright. Alongside its private operating companies, Björn has made substantial investments in listed growth businesses, including Svenska Aerogel and digital-health company iZafe. His approach combines concentrated shareholdings with direct governance, using the holding company to allocate capital across property and operating businesses.
